key_provisions_or_claims: Guidelines for adoption, procurement and development of AI systems by Italian public administrations, issued under the CAD and the 2024-2026 Three-Year IT Plan.
Risk classification of AI systems aligned with the EU AI Act, with risk assessment and impact assessment annexes.
Ethical governance, including a model code of ethics for PAs.
Requirements for data management and quality, personal data protection and cybersecurity of AI systems.
Staff training and skills development, performance indicators with SLAs, and lifecycle monitoring and supplier audits.
annotation.summary_en: AgID's draft guidelines (v1.0, 14 Feb 2025, public consultation) for adopting AI in Italian public administration. They cover risk classification aligned with the EU AI Act, ethical governance, data quality, data protection, cybersecurity, training, communication, lifecycle monitoring and supplier audits, with annexes on maturity, risk and impact assessment, a model ethics code and KPIs.
annotation.title_clean: Bozza di linee guida per l'adozione di Intelligenza Artificiale nella pubblica amministrazione
annotation.title_en: Draft Guidelines for the Adoption of Artificial Intelligence in Public Administration
